figurative_meaning_en: To inquire about or check on someone
example_sentences_in_bangla: বন্ধুর অসুস্থতার খবর পেয়ে আমি তার খবর নিলাম।
example_sentences_in_english: I check on him every day.
Upon hearing about my friend's illness, I inquired about him.
note: This idiom reflects the cultural emphasis on maintaining personal connections in Bengali society.
